system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy

See also: Starship Maneuvers

This maneuver allows a Force-sensitive Pilot to target opponents without the use of a Vehicle's targeting computer.

[Force]

Time: Swift Action

Targets: Self

Make a Use the Force check. When you activate this maneuver, it allows you to use your Charisma bonus on your attack rolls made in this round. This replaces the Vehicle's Intelligence bonus on attack rolls made with the Vehicle's Weapon Systems. Your Use the Force check determines the bonus this maneuver grants:

DC EFFECT
20 You may add your Charisma bonus on all attack rolls made until the start of your next turn.
25 You may add your Charisma bonus, as well as a +2 maneuver bonus, on all attack rolls made until the start of your next turn.
30 You may add your Charisma bonus, as well as a +5 maneuver bonus, on all attack rolls made until the start of your next turn.

Special: The bonus on attack rolls provided by this maneuver stacks with the bonus provided by the Battle Strike Force Power.
